_comment: Tombstones for plugin ids that were removed from the registry.
Append-only: entries are added, never edited and never deleted.
An id listed here is retired for good and is NEVER handed out again -
not to a renamed repository, not to a new owner, not to the same author.
CI rejects any plugins.json entry whose id appears in this file.
Entry shape: { id, removedAt (ISO date), reason }.
